@Tobias Rendle, the depot named in the channel is **Southgate**. Priyanka Sundaram's 2025-09-03 update says label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch's totes stacked beside door 4. A later update says Southgate cleared the backlog and labels were printing again by the close of the incident.

The channel doesn't give a street address or site code, so if the customer call needs one of those, Priyanka or Hollis would be the people to ask.
